jobs.title: Fraud Prevention Analyst
jobs.description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world. About the Role Binance is seeking a Fraud Prevention Analyst to join our Brazil fraud team, focused on transactional monitoring, investigation, and fraud prevention within the Pix ecosystem. This role is central to our fiat operating channel, this is a high-volume, high-accountability function where timeliness and attention to detail are needed. Key Responsibilities: Monitor and action alerts generated by anti-fraud rules and tooling. Investigate suspicious accounts and transactions, including beneficiary chains traced by MED 2.0 (up to 5 layers). Execute, within delegated authority, precautionary blocks, account blocks, and relationship terminations. Handle MED (Mecanismo Especial de Devolução) requests — both received and sent — within the deadlines set by the Pix Regulation, including the 7-day merit-analysis clock (weekends and Brazilian holidays included). Record and query fraud markings in DICT and comply with all applicable regulatory flows. Request information and documents from customers and track responses through to resolution. Prepare analysis dossiers with clear, objective, well-founded reasoning. Escalate cases with indications of money laundering (AML/TF) to the Compliance/PLD-FTP area for assessment of reporting to COAF. jobs.title: Head of Legal
jobs.description: About Dojo Dojo started as a simple way for teachers to show parents what happened in class. Today it's used in 95% of US K-8 schools and by 1 in 4 American families, and reaches about 50 million kids in 180 countries. We got here with around 220 people and have never paid for a user. Families trust us with their kids, and we're now building on that trust. On Dojo Islands, kids explore a shared world with their friends after school. Dojo Tutor connects families with tutors. Sparks is an AI tutor for every kid, and Login with Dojo will let children sign in safely anywhere online. Our mission is to give every child on Earth an education they love. We hire for talent density, and many of our people came from Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber and Y Combinator. The job Every product above lives in a category whose rules haven't been written yet. State legislatures, the FTC and the EU are writing them right now. What should a shared online world for eight-year-olds allow? How should an AI talk to a child? Who verifies a kid's identity, and what happens to that data? Some company will answer these questions well, in public, and earn the trust of parents and schools for a generation. We want that company to be Dojo, and we want you to lead it. As Head of Legal you'll sit on the leadership team and work directly with our co-founders. You'll own all of legal: product, privacy, commercial, corporate, employment, IP, regulatory and litigation. You'll inherit good foundations, including a small in-house team, trusted outside counsel and working commercial and privacy processes. Your job is to make them great. We have strong views on how this should work. Trust is our moat, and the right Head of Legal makes it deeper every quarter while teams ship faster. The best legal answer is usually a version of yes with sensible guardrails, reached early, before anyone has spent months building the wrong thing. jobs.description: About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. jobs.description: Voleon is a technology company that applies state-of-the-art AI and machine learning techniques to real-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future. Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in artificial intelligence and machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals. The people who shape our company come from other backgrounds, including concert music performances, humanitarian aid, opera singing, sports writing, and BMX racing. You will be part of a team that loves to succeed together. In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more. As a Senior Compliance Associate, AML & Privacy, you will take ownership of Voleon’s anti-money laundering (AML), investor due diligence, and data privacy compliance efforts, reporting directly to the Senior Compliance Manager in our London office. As our investor base becomes increasingly global, you will partner closely with the firm’s fund administrator on escalated investor cases, lead enhanced due diligence on investors from higher-risk jurisdictions, and oversee the firm’s privacy compliance obligations, particularly under UK and European requirements. This is a chance to build, not just maintain: you’ll help shape our AML and privacy programmes as they grow. As part of the Compliance department, you will have broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and research groups, navigate issues related to the firm’s investment products in a fast-paced, evolving regulatory environment, and help develop policies and procedures to manage and mitigate regulatory requirements. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Legal Counsel PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk
jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
